essence: Upāṃśu recitation is defined as sound audible only to the reciter's own ear.
Upāṃśu recitation is ten times superior to loud recitation.
Mental recitation surpasses tongue recitation in efficacy.
Continuous, unbroken recitation of syllables preserves the fruit of japa.
Broken recitation fails to yield its intended result.
